about: A demo run, replayed from a live gpt-6-luna run (1014-165840-9408) at about 25x speed. The planner's question and every agent's edits and reports are that run's; in the live run the owner tried all six model families, and here you choose. The tests, checks and budget caps run for real on a fresh copy of repo/. Code identical to the live run's gets the score already measured for it, from scores.json (LUCIDITY_RESCORE=1 recomputes them all, about 10 minutes, mostly the SVM); any other code is scored for real. Agents were refused the held-out years; only Lucidity scored them. Returns are from Kenneth French's Data Library (49 industry portfolios, built from CRSP).
title: Stock returns

card.ask: Which industries beat the median next month? From past returns only.

blurb: A model predicts which of 49 industries will beat the median industry next month, from past returns only. A coin flip scores 0.6931 log loss and the goal is 0.6925. Six kinds of model are tried at once, one agent each, tuning on 2010-2016. Lucidity scores every attempt on 2017-2026, years the agents never see, and recommends the best, or tells you none of them works.
split: Trained on 1971-2009, tuned on 2010-2016, tested on 2017-2026. Agents never see the test years; only Lucidity scores them.
about_repo: bundled industry-return model: 49 industries, monthly 1970-2026, logistic regression, evals/score.py
commit_message: stockkit: last month + last year returns, logistic regression, 49 industries 1970-2026, evals/score.py
goal: Get held-out log loss to 0.6925 or lower (a coin flip scores 0.6931) for predicting which industries beat the median next month, without accuracy dropping. Tune on the dev split. Ask the owner which model families to try (kNN, SVM, lasso or ridge logistic regression, random forest, boosted trees), then build each one in parallel and keep the best. Give each agent up to 4 rounds.

plan.summary: Build and compare the owner-approved model families on the dev split, selecting the best model while preserving the no-lookahead guarantee. Evaluate the selected approach on heldout with a log-loss target of 0.6925 or lower and no accuracy regression. Total estimated budget: $2.00.

nodes.title: Build and compare approved model families
nodes.prompt: For the model family selected by the owner, implement a scikit-learn-shaped estimator in stockkit/model.py or an appropriately contained module. Tune only on the dev split, compare log loss and accuracy, and ensure the model uses no future data. Keep candidate implementations isolated enough that the final selection can choose the best approved family. Heldout goal: log loss <= 0.6925 with accuracy not below the repository baseline. Do not optimize on heldout.
strategies: kNN. Implement a k-nearest-neighbors classifier with dev-tuned neighbors and probability smoothing; use only information allowed by the existing feature pipeline.
SVM. Implement an SVM classifier with dev-tuned kernel and regularization, scaling features and calibrating probabilities using training data only.
Lasso logistic regression. Implement l1-regularized logistic regression and tune its regularization on dev; preserve fit/predict_proba interface.
Ridge logistic regression. Implement l2-regularized logistic regression and tune its regularization on dev; preserve fit/predict_proba interface.
Random forest. Implement a random forest classifier and tune depth, leaf size, and probability behavior on dev.
Boosted trees. Implement a gradient-boosted tree classifier and tune depth, learning rate, and regularization on dev.

nodes.title: Select best candidate and validate final pipeline
nodes.prompt: After candidate work is complete, select the approved model with the best dev performance, integrate it as the default model, and verify compatibility with the score script and no-lookahead tests. Do not tune or choose based on heldout outcomes; report heldout evaluation only as final validation.

questions.question: Which model families should agents try? Select one or more; each selected family gets its own parallel agent.

modelsa-r1.report: I replaced logistic regression with a prior-smoothed kNN classifier and tuned it on the dev split, where it scored 0.6932 log loss and 0.4933 accuracy. Tests pass, but the score conditions do not: dev accuracy is below baseline, and the heldout score was unavailable.

modelsa-r2.report: I kept the model as a prior-smoothed kNN and increased smoothing after checking dev performance; tests pass and dev log loss is 0.6931. The held-out score could not be verified because the evaluator refused access, so the held-out log-loss and accuracy conditions are not confirmed.

modelsa-r3.report: I restored the prior-smoothed kNN classifier after testing a more aggressive neighbor configuration, which performed worse on the dev split. The tests pass, but the held-out score and accuracy conditions remain unverified here; the dev score is 0.6931 log loss and 0.5017 accuracy, so the requested conditions are not demonstrated.

modelsa-r4.report: I restored the kNN classifier to a conservatively smoothed configuration after more aggressive settings performed worse on the dev split. The tests pass, but the heldout score was refused in this agent environment, so the log-loss and accuracy conditions are not confirmed.
